Content: MemorySmith.Benchmarks is an active solution project for BenchmarkDotNet coverage of lexical, semantic, hybrid, chat-context hybrid, and context-pack workloads. The chat-context workload queries terms such as stop generating, model used, GitHub, Haiku, history, context usage, Ctrl+V paste, and intercepted MCP/wiki tool calls so benchmark smoke catches whether the live project wiki stays useful for chat/search dogfooding. Use dotnet run -c Release --project MemorySmith.Benchmarks -- --smoke for fast construction/runtime validation and dotnet run -c Release --project MemorySmith.Benchmarks -- --filter *SearchBenchmarks* for the benchmark suite.
Title: BenchmarkDotNet search benchmark suite
